Software Engineer (Contract) at FinanceHub

FinanceHub is seeking a Software Engineer on a 6-month W2 contract basis with strong potential to convert to full-time employment based on performance.

Project scope:
- Migrate legacy Java monolith to Spring Boot microservices
- Implement REST APIs consumed by mobile and web clients
- Write comprehensive JUnit tests targeting 80%+ coverage

Required:
- Java 17+ and Spring Boot
- REST API design and OpenAPI/Swagger documentation
- JUnit 5 and Mockito
- Git and Maven or Gradle
- Experience with microservices architecture

This is a W2 contract through our staffing partner. No C2C arrangements.
Duration: 6 months with conversion option.
Location: Hybrid in Chicago, IL.

Apply at financehub.com/contractors
